CustomField.description: Staging mirror of GiftTransaction.FQS_Stewardship_Date__c. Carries a manual override date when stewardship was performed outside the automated flow (personal note, phone call, in-person). Written to GiftTransaction.FQS_Stewardship_Date__c on commit. Blank on most entries — the automated FQS_Stewardship_Response flow writes the field post-commit when the stewardship touch is delivered.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date the stewardship follow-up occurred — only fill in if stewardship happened outside Salesforce. The automated stewardship flow otherwise writes this on delivery.
CustomField.label: Stewardship Date
